name: Memory
about: Scrum Master 3's LIVE Memory, on demand: the 3 way switch works or not (the knowledge store reads, Claude Code's hooks are wired, every known-answer question is answered right through the knowledge door's read-only ask), and the memory's live updates today, as information.

facts.store_step: put the store back from the newest backup (seconds): cp "$(ls -d ~/scratch/scrum_master/backups/scrum_master_*/knowledge.db | tail -1)" ~/virtual_sanity/knowledge/instance/knowledge.db, then ~/virtual_sanity/knowledge/bin/knowledge ask "<a known question>"
facts.questions_step: write the known-answer questions file (question, expect for each), never from the session that builds the switch
facts.door_step: see the door's fault whole by hand (seconds): ~/virtual_sanity/knowledge/bin/knowledge ask "<question {n}>"; a fault in its code is code work, sent as a request
facts.switch_step: ask question {n} alone (seconds): ~/virtual_sanity/knowledge/bin/knowledge ask "<question {n}>"; its right answer turns this green. The switch's fix itself is a builder's (~/virtual_sanity/knowledge/app/knowledge/switch.py), sent as a request
facts.settings_step: make ~/.claude/settings.json read again (seconds): python3 -m json.tool ~/.claude/settings.json names the broken line; mend it, then press RUN on Memory
facts.old_hook_step: take the old Cortex hook out of ~/.claude/settings.json: the UserPromptSubmit or SessionStart entry whose command names cortex (seconds)

card.pitch: The 3 way switch works or not, and the memory's live updates
